# charan-rathore/IntelliRAG #2: Cleanup: one live Vercel host + delete intellirag-web mirror

State: open

## Why two URLs behaved differently

- `https://intellirag-web.vercel.app/` is a **public** production deployment. Keep it.
- `https://intellirag-live-own-track.vercel.app/` is **Vercel Authentication / SSO** for the `own-track` team. Unauthenticated visitors get `vercel.com/login`. That is not an app crash.

The Vercel MCP connected here only lists team projects `memo-rable` and `thermosense`. IntelliRAG hosts live on the personal Vercel account, so this issue is the checklist for the dashboard clicks that APIs here cannot finish.

## Do in Vercel (personal account + own-track team)

1. Keep project that serves `intellirag-web.vercel.app`.
2. Point that project at **this** repo with Root Directory `web/` (not the `intellirag-web` GitHub repo).
3. Delete the project behind `intellirag-live-own-track.vercel.app` (or disable Deployment Protection only if you still need that hostname).
4. Confirm no second IntelliRAG project remains.

## Do on GitHub

1. Delete `charan-rathore/intellirag-web` (Settings → Danger zone). It is a mirror of `web/`.
2. Keep developing here. See [WEB.md](../blob/main/WEB.md) and [ROADMAP.md](../blob/main/ROADMAP.md).

## Next product work

Graphify-backed graph view for non-technical users + graph-aware RAG evals (Phase 13–14 in ROADMAP.md).
